notifications.title: Proposal: let the variant system judge the music genre
notifications.detail: Across 45 Shorts with 48-hour views, the music genre is the clearest sound signal we have: pop 2.85x the median (n=10), lofi 1.90x (n=6), cinematic 1.36x (n=10, best % viewed at 64.7%), synthwave 0.48x (n=10), acoustic 0.22x (n=6). The genre is still picked at random by generator/variety.py, so a third of Shorts get our two weakest beds. Both variety.py and config/arms.json are owner-only, so no agent can change this.
notifications.fix: 1. In config/arms.json add a dimension like "music": {"options": ["pop", "cinematic", "lofi", "synthwave", "acoustic"], "default": "pop", "since": "2026-11-10", "why": "music genre"} and map style.genre to it in improvement/arms.py; the rotation rule (not the previous video's genre) still applies. 2. Or simpler: remove "acoustic" from GENRES in renderer/engine/music_constants.py. 3. Or do nothing and let the improver's music-follows-story experiment test it.

notifications.title: Your '30 seconds at least' note conflicts with the variant system
notifications.detail: On v-20261105-06 (the $10 gym, 27 s, 920 views) you asked for Shorts of at least 30 s. The variant system has since dropped the 28-35 s option and made 20-27 s the default (config/arms.json). Our numbers so far: 25-29 s Shorts 12.5x the median (n=5), 30-34 s 1.8x (n=5). config/arms.json is owner-only, so no agent can follow your note.
notifications.fix: 1. If you want 30 s or more: in config/arms.json set dimensions.length.default to "28-35" and remove it from dropped (or add a "30-35" option). 2. If you'd rather let the numbers decide, do nothing; the variant system keeps judging 48-hour views.

notifications.title: A published Short shows the same amount two different ways
notifications.detail: v-20261017-04 ('How much do impulse orders really cost you in 15 years?') shows '₹6.5 L gone' at 15.9 s but 'Put in ₹6.4 L' at 26.7 s, and 'Worth ₹16.3 L' at 26.7 s but '₹16.5 L' on the bar at 32.2 s. It is one of the channel's most-viewed videos (284 views). It was made by the old money_leak_meter template, which no longer exists; the adopted same-figure-same-text check stops new videos doing this.
notifications.fix: Only the owner handles uploads: in YouTube Studio, open that Short and either set it to Private/Unlisted or leave it up (the gap is a rounding and convention difference, not a wrong claim). Nothing to change in the repo.

notifications.title: Optional: listen to two better-rated voices for the narrator
notifications.detail: Kokoro's own grades: af_heart A, af_bella A-, bf_emma (British) B-, but am_michael, am_fenrir and am_puck only C+. Voices are picked by your ear, so research hasn't proposed a change.
notifications.fix: 1. On your computer: bash scripts/setup-voice.sh, then make a short sample with bf_emma and am_michael (renderer/engine/voice.py speak_timed). 2. If you like one, ask the improver (or edit NARRATOR_VOICES in renderer/timeline/build.py) to add it. 3. Otherwise ignore this.

notifications.title: YouTube changes Shorts monetisation on 1 Feb 2027
notifications.detail: YouTube's own blog (10 Aug 2026): from 1 Feb 2027 new Partner Program applicants need 8,000 watch hours in 365 days or 20 million Shorts views in 90 days, and Shorts ad/Premium revenue goes only to channels with 10 million Shorts views in the last 90 days. Channels below that keep long-video earnings. For us that means long videos are the realistic path to revenue; Shorts mainly grow the audience. Nothing changes in the pipeline.
notifications.fix: 1. Nothing to do now. 2. In YouTube Studio > Earn, check the current entry bar and whether the channel can apply before 1 Feb 2027. 3. If you want long videos weighted more, change longPerWeek in settings (owner-only). Source: https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/youtube-partner-program-updates-2027-new-opportunities-earn/

notifications.title: Your note asks for real faces and logos; the hard rules forbid downloaded images
notifications.detail: On v-20261103-02 you asked for 'real images of personality and products… people faces and products logos', and on v-20261103-01 for real Apple and Google icons. CLAUDE.md and agents/policy.md say no downloaded images and no copyrighted assets, so no agent may add them. Research proposed the allowed version tonight: a coded name tile for each company (its name in our font on a flat colour, never a copied logo, `company-wordmark-not-fake-icon`) and a one-clause intro for each real person (`person-intro-tag`). Real logos would usually count as nominative use when the video is about that company, but that is a legal call, and photos of people carry their photographers' copyright and the person's publicity rights.
notifications.fix: 1. If the coded name tiles are enough, do nothing. 2. If you want real logos: decide it yourself, amend the 'All audio/no copyrighted assets' and 'no downloaded images' lines in CLAUDE.md and agents/policy.md to allow official logos from each company's own press or brand page (ideally after reading that company's brand guidelines), and say where files may live (e.g. assets/brands/, committed by you). 3. Real photos of people are not recommended; drawn caricatures of real people are also risky, so keep name cards.

notifications.title: Two variant options to consider: a 'trap' topic and a cast-skit voice
notifications.detail: Your 4 Nov note says every topic is now one category. One reason: the variant system's topic option 'budget' (dropped at 0.14x, n=10) holds every non-core format, including trap_alert ('The no-cost EMI trap', 721 views) and which_one_are_you ('Same job, same $60,000 salary', 793). So only the four core formats are left. Research has widened the subjects inside core formats tonight (airline, sports, bonus, gold). Separately, python -m improvement.evaluate shows Shorts where the narrator speaks under 25% of the words (the October skits, cast acting the lines) at 4.3x the median (n=12), against 0.24x when the narrator speaks 75-100% (n=6). This overlaps with length and era, and one-voice narration is your rule from 26 Oct, so no agent may test it.
notifications.fix: 1. If you want trap stories back in the test: in config/arms.json add 'trap' to dimensions.topic.options and map story trap_alert to it on the "topic" line in improvement/arms.py (about line 89, where non-core stories become "budget"), so it is judged on its own instead of with budgeting. 2. If you want to test cast-acted Shorts: add a dimension like "voice": {"options": ["narrator", "cast"], "default": "narrator"} and relax the one-voice line in CLAUDE.md for the 'cast' option. 3. Otherwise ignore this; nothing breaks.
